subject: Music Production
title: The Legendary Neve Console
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on The Legendary Neve Console.

hook.text: Rupert Neve designed his first recording console in a small workshop in Cambridge, England.

buildup.text: His circuits used transformers that added a warm, musical coloring to every signal passing through.

discovery.text: Engineers discovered that Neve consoles made recordings sound richer without any additional effort.

twist.text: Vintage Neve consoles now sell for hundreds of thousands of dollars at studio equipment auctions.

climax.text: The 'Neve sound' remains the gold standard for console warmth in professional studios worldwide.

punchline.text: One engineer's circuits became studio gold.

quiz.question: What gave Neve consoles their distinctive warm sound?
options: Transformers that colored the signal musically
